context_requirements: Expression of imidazoline receptor subtypes (e.g., I1, I2, I3) in the assayed cell lines
A functional signaling pathway downstream of imidazoline receptors that can alter transcription within 6-24 h
Ligand-independent or ligand-dependent activation of imidazoline receptors in these cell lines
falsifiers: Observation of reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of imidazoline receptor pathway genes among differentially expressed landmark genes
Consistent changes in genes known to be regulated by imidazoline receptor signaling (e.g., insulin secretion, catecholamine release) in responsive lines
